details.description: Ministral 3 14B is Mistral AI's 14-billion-parameter edge model from the December 2025 Ministral 3 family, built for on-device deployment with text and image (vision) input. It is released under the Apache 2.0 license alongside base, instruct, and reasoning variants at the same size, and Mistral says the Ministral 3 lineup natively supports 40+ languages and aims for the best cost-to-performance ratio of any open-weight model, with instruct variants often using fewer tokens than comparable models at similar performance.
advantages: Optimized for on-device and edge deployment while maintaining strong performance on knowledge and reasoning tasks, per Amazon Bedrock's model card.
Accepts image input alongside text, for tasks that combine visual and text understanding.
Released under the Apache 2.0 license, allowing open commercial and derivative use.
Part of the Ministral 3 family, which Mistral says reaches the best cost-to-performance ratio of any open-weight model.
disadvantages: No audio or video input support.
use_cases: On-device and edge deployment for knowledge and reasoning tasks
Combined vision-and-text tasks such as describing or reasoning about images

notes: Mistral reports 85% on AIME '25 for the 14B reasoning variant, but this catalog entry (mistral.ministral-3-14b-instruct) is the instruct variant, a sibling model, so that score was left out rather than misattributed. Mistral's own pages mostly describe capabilities at the whole Ministral 3 family level (3B/8B/14B); no instruct-specific accuracy benchmark for this exact model was found. Context window (128K) and max output (8K) match the catalog facts.
